text:
anita: FYI - spun up delta12b-int6 on staging for a mixed-fleet canary. Initial unit econ looks promising but seeing regressions on long-form summarization slices.

leo: Can you paste sample diffs? which metric dropping?

anita: ROUGE-L down ~6 pts vs baseline on long-doc slice (>=2k tokens). Hallucination rate from our QA checks up from ~2% -> ~7% for extractive facts.

maria: That's material. What's p95 latency / throughput?

anita: p95 token gen latency ~210ms on staging (baseline ~150ms). Throughput is ~1.6x tokens/sec. Cost per 1k tokens ~ $0.27 vs baseline 13B fp16 ~$0.62. Cost win is clear but recall drop is concerning.

ashok: @maria @anita can we run quick product-impact calc? If GTN-quality drops that could translate to churn or lower conversion. Also need priming-sensitivity check.

ops_bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy completed -> ridge-canary-5 (5% traffic). Logs: https://ci.example/redwood/ridge-canary

leo: Recommend targeted slice eval: long-doc abstractive summarization, citation/QA, multi-turn contexts >3k tokens. Use shadow-run to collect direct comparisons. We used this snippet to compute unit econ locally:

```
python scripts/unit_econ.py --model delta12b-int6 --tokens 1000000 --price_per_gpu_min 1.2
```

maria: Also run shadow-run (dual-serve) where requests are mirrored to both delta and baseline for 24h; compute per-prompt cluster regression. Need >=2k samples per high-risk cluster for stable estimates.

anita: Shadow-run queued. Trying hybrid routing as a quick mitigation: short inputs -> delta, long inputs -> baseline. Config snippet: 

```
route:
  - condition: input_length <= 512
    model: delta12b-int6
  - condition: otherwise
    model: zephyr-13b-fp16
```

ashok: Hybrid looks good. Another mitigation: if hallucination_score > 0.3, re-run on baseline and merge outputs rather than full rollback. That reduces surface area.

maria: For GTN rollout: 1) keep 5% canary for 24h, 2) run 5% shadow for high-risk slices, 3) compute unit-econ including downstream product impact (churn/engagement). If long-doc regressions persist in important domains, pause rollout.

leo: Proposed scorecard fields: model_name, quant_level, cost_per_1k_tokens, p95_latency, throughput_tps, rouge_l_delta, hallucination_rate, product_impact_estimate, metric_reliability. Example rows: 
- delta12b-int6, int6, $0.27, 210ms, 1.6x, -6, 7%, -0.4% est revenue, CI +/-2.1 ROUGE pts (N=420)
- zephyr-13b-fp16, fp16, $0.62, 150ms, 1.0x, 0, 2%, 0%, baseline

anita: Agree - add 'sample_size' and 'confidence_interval' columns. Our long-doc slice N=420 (CI ~ +/-2.1 ROUGE pts).

maria: Action items:
- anita: finish shadow-run and upload slice CSV (ETA ~6h)
- leo: run priming sensitivity (3-shot vs 0-shot) and report delta (ETA ~12h)
- ashok: compute product-impact model to translate score deltas into GTN revenue risk (ETA EOD)

anita: Uploaded shadow-run results: https://s3.redwood/shadow/delta12b-2026-03-21.csv. Quick glance: recall/regressions concentrated in 'finance' and 'legal' domains.

maria: If those domains are a small fraction of GTN traffic we can continue with hybrid. If they're large, we should pause until either int6 tuning or an int8 variant.

leo: Next technical steps: try quant calibration (mixed int6/int8), evaluate KV-cache warmstart impact on long-form coherence, and run microbench for perf tomorrow.

anita: tagging @product-lead for visibility :product: 

product-lead: noted. Please include expected user-visible latency vs backlog effects in the handoff. Keep me posted.

maria: TL;DR: delta12b-int6 -> ~56% token cost reduction but measurable long-doc quality regressions in specific domains. Recommend staged hybrid canary + shadow + fallback to baseline re-run for hallucinated outputs. :white_check_mark:

leo: I'll draft a short scorecard + handoff doc for GTN and link PR here.

anita: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
